items.name: analyze
items.doc: Run the complete PUFAnalytics evaluation.

items.name: to_json
items.doc: Serialise an `analyze` result (NaN/inf -> null).

items.name: headline_rows
items.doc: Rows (metric, value, ideal, CI) shared by Markdown and LaTeX output.

items.name: to_markdown
items.doc: Render an `analyze` result as a Markdown report.

items.name: to_latex
items.doc: Render the headline metrics as a LaTeX `table` (booktabs).

items.name: parse_response
items.doc: Convert a textual response into a `uint8` bit vector.

items.name: parse_text
items.doc: Parse a textual data set.

items.name: PUFDataset
items.doc: Container for PUF response measurements.

items.name: PUFDataset.n_devices
items.doc: Number of devices (property).

items.name: PUFDataset.n_bits
items.doc: Response length in bits (property).

items.name: PUFDataset.n_measurements
items.doc: Read-outs per device, as a list (property).

items.name: PUFDataset.has_repeats
items.doc: True when any device was measured more than once (property).

items.name: PUFDataset.condition_labels
items.doc: Operating-condition labels in first-seen order (property).

items.name: PUFDataset.reference
items.doc: Enrolled reference response of every device, shape (devices, bits).

items.name: PUFDataset.to_array
items.doc: Return a `(devices, measurements, bits)` array (rectangular data only).

items.name: PUFDataset.subset
items.doc: Return a new data set restricted to the given device / bit indices.

items.name: PUFDataset.from_bitstrings
items.doc: One response string per device.

items.name: PUFDataset.from_text
items.doc: Build a data set from CSV/TXT text (see parse_text).

items.name: PUFDataset.from_file
items.doc: Load a `.csv`/`.txt` (see `parse_text`), `.npy` or `.json` file.

items.name: PUFDataset.to_csv
items.doc: Write the long `device,measurement,condition,response` format.

items.name: PUFDataset.to_dict
items.doc: Plain dict for JSON export; the web app imports it.

items.name: PUFDataset.from_dict
items.doc: Rebuild a data set from to_dict() output.

items.name: as_dataset
items.doc: Coerce supported inputs into a `PUFDataset`.

items.name: uniformity
items.doc: Uniformity (fraction of 1s, %) of each device's reference response. Ideal 50 %.

items.name: bit_aliasing
items.doc: Bit-aliasing (%) per bit position across devices. Ideal 50 %.

items.name: inter_hd_matrix
items.doc: Symmetric `devices x devices` matrix of inter-device Hamming distances.

items.name: inter_hd
items.doc: All pairwise inter-device Hamming distances (integer), upper triangle.

items.name: uniqueness
items.doc: Uniqueness: mean pairwise inter-device fHD in %. Ideal 50 %.

items.name: intra_hd
items.doc: Intra-device Hamming distances between the reference and every re-measurement.

items.name: reliability
items.doc: Reliability (%) per device: `100 - mean intra fHD * 100`. Ideal 100 %.

items.name: steadiness
items.doc: Steadiness (%) per device (Maiti et al.): `100 (1 + mean_l log2 max(p_l, 1-p_l))`.

items.name: bit_flip_rate
items.doc: Per-bit error rate: probability that bit `l` differs from the reference.

items.name: stable_bit_ratio
items.doc: Fraction of (device, bit) cells that never changed over all measurements.

items.name: condition_ber
items.doc: Mean bit error rate w.r.t. the enrolment read-out, per operating condition.

items.name: hamming_weights
items.doc: Hamming weight of every device's reference response.

items.name: bit_correlation_matrix
items.doc: Pearson (phi) correlation between bit positions across devices.

items.name: autocorrelation
items.doc: Mean normalised autocorrelation of the reference responses (±1 mapping).

items.name: bit_entropy
items.doc: Shannon entropy (bits) of every bit position across the device population.

items.name: bit_min_entropy
items.doc: Min-entropy (bits) of every bit position across the device population.

items.name: tmv_ber
items.doc: Bit error rate after temporal majority voting (TMV) over `m` read-outs.

items.name: igam
items.doc: Regularised lower incomplete gamma function P(a, x).

items.name: igamc
items.doc: Regularised upper incomplete gamma function Q(a, x) = 1 - P(a, x).

items.name: normal_cdf
items.doc: Standard normal cumulative distribution function.

items.name: binom_logpmf
items.doc: Natural log of the binomial probability mass function.

items.name: binom_pmf_vector
items.doc: Return the binomial pmf for k = 0..n as a NumPy array.

items.name: binom_cdf
items.doc: P(X <= k) for X ~ Binomial(n, p), accurate deep into the tails.

items.name: binom_sf
items.doc: P(X > k) for X ~ Binomial(n, p), accurate deep into the tails.

items.name: decidability
items.doc: Decidability index d' (Daugman) between intra- and inter-distance sets.

items.name: histogram_counts
items.doc: Histogram of integer Hamming distances on the support 0..n_bits.

items.name: far_frr_curve
items.doc: Empirical FAR / FRR as a function of the HD acceptance threshold.

items.name: equal_error_rate
items.doc: Equal error rate and the threshold index where it is attained.

items.name: binomial_fit
items.doc: Fit a binomial model `Binomial(n_bits, p)` to Hamming distances.

items.name: binomial_far_frr
items.doc: FAR / FRR under the independent-bit binomial model.

items.name: percentile_ci
items.doc: Two-sided percentile confidence interval of bootstrap replicates.

items.name: bootstrap_indices
items.doc: Generate bootstrap index sets with the portable RNG (reproducible).

items.name: identification_vs_length
items.doc: Binomial-model identification error `min_t max(FAR, FRR)` for each response length.

items.name: monobit
items.doc: 2.1 Frequency (monobit) test. Requires n >= 100.

items.name: block_frequency
items.doc: 2.2 Frequency test within a block. Requires n >= 100.

items.name: runs
items.doc: 2.3 Runs test. Requires n >= 100.

items.name: longest_run
items.doc: 2.4 Test for the longest run of ones in a block. Requires n >= 128.

items.name: cumulative_sums
items.doc: 2.13 Cumulative sums (forward and backward). Requires n >= 100.

items.name: approximate_entropy
items.doc: 2.12 Approximate entropy test. Requires m < floor(log2 n) - 5.

items.name: serial
items.doc: 2.11 Serial test (two p-values). Requires m < floor(log2 n) - 2.

items.name: spectral
items.doc: 2.6 Discrete Fourier transform (spectral) test. Requires n >= 1000.

items.name: run_all
items.doc: Run every implemented SP 800-22 test and return a list of results.

items.name: shannon_entropy_rate
items.doc: Shannon entropy (bits per bit) of the empirical 0/1 distribution.

items.name: mcv_min_entropy
items.doc: SP 800-90B Most Common Value min-entropy estimate (bits per bit).

items.name: markov_min_entropy
items.doc: SP 800-90B Markov min-entropy estimate for binary data (bits per bit).

items.name: lz_complexity
items.doc: Normalised Lempel-Ziv (1976) complexity `c(n) log2(n) / n`.

items.name: population_entropy
items.doc: Summary of per-position entropy across a device population.

items.name: arbiter_features
items.doc: Parity feature transform of the additive delay model.

items.name: ff_loops
items.doc: (source, destination) stage pairs of evenly spaced, non-overlapping feed-forward loops.

items.name: simulate
items.doc: Simulate a PUF population.

items.name: quick_metrics
items.doc: Fast headline metrics (no bootstrap, no NIST) used by sweeps.

items.name: sweep
items.doc: Sweep one (or two) simulator parameters.

items.name: logistic_regression
items.doc: Fit ridge-regularised logistic regression with Newton's method.

items.name: modeling_attack
items.doc: Learning curve of a logistic-regression attack on supplied CRPs.

items.name: simulated_attack
items.doc: Learning curve of the attack against a simulated (k-XOR) Arbiter PUF.

items.name: repetition_error
items.doc: Residual bit error after majority decoding of an `(r,1)` repetition code.

items.name: block_failure
items.doc: Probability that a block of `n` bits has more than `t` errors.

items.name: plan_key_generation
items.doc: Enumerate ECC configurations and report the feasible ones.

items.name: PortableRNG
items.doc: xoshiro128** generator with a SplitMix32 seeder.

items.name: PortableRNG.next_u32
items.doc: Return the next unsigned 32-bit integer.

items.name: PortableRNG.random
items.doc: Uniform double in [0, 1).

items.name: PortableRNG.bit
items.doc: A single fair random bit (the most significant bit of the output).

items.name: PortableRNG.normal
items.doc: Standard normal variate (Box-Muller, cosine branch).

items.name: PortableRNG.randint
items.doc: Uniform integer in `[0, n)`.

items.name: PortableRNG.bits
items.doc: Return a list of `count` fair bits.

items.name: PortableRNG.normals
items.doc: Return a list of `count` standard normal variates.

items.name: PortableRNG.randoms
items.doc: Return a list of `count` uniform doubles in [0, 1).

items.name: main
items.doc: Entry point of the pufanalytics command (analyze, simulate, nist, attack, ecc).
